title: Ansel and the Smile
author: Xanthe Lockridge
blurb: Noor Halloran, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
